files.description: 39-page PDF documenting AuroraEHR's (b)(10) EHI export feature. Contains export instructions, UI screenshots, and field-level data dictionary for 15+ export categories covering demographics, billing (charges/payments/transactions), clinical notes, allergies, immunizations, medications, problems/diagnoses, vital signs, orders (lab/imaging/pathology/therapy), documents/scans/reports, implanted devices, social/family/surgical history, review of systems, pre-op/post-op assessments, surgical checklists, provider orders, and more. Each CSV and PDF report category is documented with column names, descriptions, and enumerated value sets.
files.curl_command: curl -sL 'https://www.practice-alt.com/AuroraEHR_b10_EHI_Export_Documentation.pdf' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36' -o AuroraEHR_b10_EHI_Export_Documentation.pdf
